newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE TO REORGANISE RIGAS MIESNIEKS.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE TO REORGANISE RIGAS MIESNIEKS.

text.p: Rakvere Meat Factoy said on Wednesday that it will start preparing a reorganisation plan for the Latvian Rigas Miesnieks firm which it acquired recently.
"We will prepare the reorganisation plan to make the company more effective," development director Andrus Mottus told Reuters.
Mottus said that 22 people from Rakvere visited the Riga factory last week to find out about the company's strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats.
"The formation of the picture is going on and according to the situation a strategy is being built," he added.
Mottus could not say when the reorganisation plan would be ready, adding that Rakvere wanted it as quickly as possible.
Rakvere in May bought 67 percent of the shares in Rigas Miesnieks, which has a 20 percent local market share.
